title: Portfolio Editor App
description: A custom local web app to manage and publish this portfolio's content.
details: Re-architected the portfolio site to load dynamically from JSON files, and built a custom local React/Node.js editor to manage them. The editor features a one-click publish integration that computes Git diffs and pushes changes seamlessly to the live site.

title: Data Validation Assistant
description: Validate and identify issues with data.
details: An interoperable automated data validation tool that analyzes datasets against a 6-pillar framework to assist the data validation process.

title: Digital brain
description: Manage AI using a brain-like graph rather than prompts.
details:
Applying the idea of using a personal knowledge graph (PKG) to drive and monitor agentic processes and workflows.

Current nodes of my PKG: 287 (+1 since 1 day ago, +4 since 1 week ago)

title: Statistical Metadata Assistant
description: Automate the generation of statistical metadata.
details: Takes available information about a survey (e.g. survey questions, etc.) and produces necessary statistical metadata (e.g. DDI).

title: Virtual Tutor
description: Screen-aware real-time learning companion.
details: An AI tutoring assistant that syncs with the user's active screen to provide real-time, context-aware instructions and tailored learning guidance based on active workspace state.

title: Real Estate Empire
description: Ottawa real estate strategy game concept.
details: A simulation game mapped onto high-fidelity satellite imagery of Ottawa. Choose a backstory, scout listings in real neighborhoods (The Glebe, Kanata), manage cash flow, and outbid AI competitors.

title: DB Early Retirement Calculator
description: Determine FIRE date and compare your income and expenses with Canadians.
details: An early retirement calculator tailored for individuals with a Defined Benefit pension plan, mapping out the portfolio and pension timeline to find your retirement age.

title: Gmail Cleaner CLI
description: Clean your mailbox.
details: A command-line tool to clean, organize, and label emails in your Gmail inbox using IMAP. Built with Python and Rich for a polished terminal experience.

title: Drug Utilization Dashboard
description: Monitor drug utilization data at the Canada-level. (*experimental*)
details: An interactive dashboard and data pipeline monitoring utilization of drugs of concern in Canada using simulated public claims and private proxy volumes.

title: NIHB Policy Assistant
description: Find info on NIHB policies. (*experimental*)
details: An experimental AI query engine designed to provide source-cited policy answers about the Non-Insured Health Benefits program.

title: Canadian AI Jobs Report
description: Monitor what post-secondary fields will do well in an AI age. (*experimental*)
details: An interactive dashboard analyzing the economic value of Canadian college majors. Maps CIP programs to NOC occupations, displaying median salaries, 10-year job growth, competition metrics, and AI disruption risk.

title: WFA Policy Advisor
description: Find info on WFA policies. (*experimental*)
details: An interactive Canadian Federal Public Service WFA (Work Force Adjustment) advisor chatbot. Navigates complex Treasury Board guidelines, opting periods, and voluntary departures with strict documentation groundings.

title: Ottawa Recreation Discovery
description: Find Ottawa recreation centres near you.
details: A visual discovery tool and interactive map for parents to find municipal recreation facilities and summer camps in Ottawa by proximity, amenities, and geographical sectors.

title: Modular Survey Tools
description: Build surveys for mobile devices.
details: An extensible, open-source survey builder optimized for mobile devices to collect data through survey questions and sensors. Adheres to DDI lifecycle standard.

title: Bookkeeping App
description: CRA-compliant offline bookkeeping.
details: A fully offline desktop bookkeeping app for Canadian sole proprietors. Ingests credit card statement CSVs, matches receipts via local OCR (Tesseract), and auto-classifies expenses to CRA Form T2125 lines while calculating GST/HST ITCs.

title: Open Stats Lab
description: An experiment to measure and improve public data visibility for AI search engines.
details: A public data platform and experiment designed to improve how generative AI chatbots and search engines find and use Statistics Canada data. Features a 100-query pilot study analyzing why AI search engines cite static articles but miss current database values, and a controlled experiment using structured HTML table mirrors (with schema.org/Dataset JSON-LD markup) on GitHub Pages to test crawlability.

title: Ottawa Global Benchmark Engine
description: Comparative global city indicators dashboard.
details: A comparative analytics dashboard comparing Ottawa with global peer cities (Austin, Adelaide, Helsinki) across labour, housing, and tech-sector benchmarks. Uses Python to extract data from Statistics Canada's CODR API, FRED, ABS, and Statistics Finland, with a DuckDB-Wasm backend in the browser for fast, on-the-fly index baseline and divergence trend analysis.

title: Local Investment Analyzer
description: Privacy-first stock and real estate comparison engine.
details: A client-side, privacy-first comparison engine built using vanilla HTML/JS/CSS and Chart.js. Model and compare long-term stock market compounding curves against leveraged real estate investments. Features an integrated SEC Edgar scraper for fundamental financial analysis, historical financial charting, real-time portfolio tracking (gain/loss & average cost basis), and local JSON data import/export for zero-cloud persistence.

title: Ottawa Transit Live Tracker
description: Real-time 2D/3D GTFS bus fleet visualizer and schedule variance monitor for Ottawa.
details: A real-time OC Transpo transit monitoring app built with React 19, Three.js, Leaflet, and Vite. Ingests GTFS Realtime feeds to stream live vehicle positions using 60 FPS dead-reckoning interpolation over OpenStreetMap tiles. Features a collapsible left-hand HUD pane, an interactive schedule-variance slider to highlight off-schedule routes, route filtering, and a 3D vehicle spectate mode.

title: Debate Game
description: Facilitate children's debate games.
details: A mobile-first debate facilitator for kids. Two named teams take turns arguing a randomly drawn topic.

title: n-1
description: Fun anagram word game with a twist.
details: A mobile-first word game (PWA) where players find all the shorter words hidden inside a 7-letter starter word by removing one letter at a time. Progress through 4 levels of increasing word length, racing against a 2-minute timer. Find the hidden bonus word to earn extra hints. Daily leaderboard included.

title: WordString
description: A cozy word puzzle with a sewing twist.
details: A mobile-first, offline-first word game (PWA) wrapped in a warm sewing-and-yarn aesthetic. Spell words horizontally from the last letter of a vertical starter word using a pool of colorful thread-spool tiles. Race the clock, earn time bonuses for longer words, and trigger playful mascot celebrations. Daily leaderboard included.

title: Wobbleton — Tower Workshop
description: Cozy 3D physics-based tower building sandbox.
details: A browser-based 3D physics sandbox built with Three.js. Design and stack towers using 5 materials (straw, wood, brick, stone, glass) with custom friction and weights. Test your creations against earthquakes, tornadoes, meteors, and windstorms. Features a custom rigid-body physics engine (sleeping/waking bodies) and procedural lo-fi soundtrack loops generated via the Web Audio API.

title: Capability Atlas
description: Modular Enterprise Business Architecture (EBA) application.
details: A modular planning tool designed for public sector agencies. Features a 3-pass overlap detection system (structural duplication, semantic near-duplicates, and shared data-effort dependencies) and an automated transition roadmap engine that topologically sequences work packages and greedy-packs them into fiscal-year envelopes. Supports live client-side PDF business case generation.

title: Wobbleton — Game Night
description: Offline-first local 2-player PWA party game hub.
details: A PWA party game hub containing 18 physics-based and turn-based mini-games (e.g. Tug o' Rope, Frosty Pond, Log Joust, Statue Race, Boxy Match) designed for 2 players sharing a single device. Built using Three.js and vanilla JS, optimized for mobile camera scaling, and packaged as an installable offline-first application.

title: Kingdoms of Wobbleton
description: A browser-based 3D medieval RTS game prototype built with Three.js.
details: A cozy boxy-vector medieval real-time strategy (RTS) game prototype built with Three.js and Vite. Features procedural seeded map generation, a deterministic simulation engine supporting up to 4-player lobbies and online play hosted on Render (wss://rtswobble.onrender.com), dynamic fog of war, 2-age technology upgrades, and advanced mechanics (shift-queueing, walls, double-tap control groups, double-click multi-selection), glTF assets, and synthesized runtime audio.

title: WatSPEED Agentic AI Hub
description: Agentic AI study suite bridging legacy analytics to LLM workflows.
details: A comprehensive learning accelerator for the University of Waterloo's WatSPEED Agentic AI program. Features a SAS/Stata-to-LLM Rosetta Stone, Scikit-Learn vs. Google TabFM zero-shot tabular classification, LangGraph state graphs, MCP server tool integration, and 9 executable Jupyter notebooks.

title: RAP Studio — Analytical Pipelines
description: Reproducible Analytical Pipelines maturity model & data engineering guide.
details: A structured data engineering framework guiding teams from loose script folders to production-ready Reproducible Analytical Pipelines (RAP). Covers locked environment isolation (pyproject.toml), declarative DAG task orchestration (Prefect/DVC), automated schema testing (pytest), and GitHub Actions CI/CD.

title: Philosopher's Quest & Mental Models
description: Gamified arcade introducing 8 to 12-year-olds to philosophy & mental models.
details: A vibrant, interactive learning portal for kids. Features collectible thinker cards (Socrates, Hypatia, Popper), interactive thought experiments (Plato's Cave, Ship of Theseus), mental model superpowers (First Principles, Occam's Razor), and a logical fallacy monster spotter game.
